summary: Release mission admission capacity immediately on cancellation

replay.detail: Existing cancellation phases are already projected locally and on replicas; no replay or history rewrite is needed.

schema.detail: Admission uses the existing mission run phase and current revision tables. No new tables or indexes.

rules.detail: Active-run admission capacity excludes final-cancelled and cleanup-cancelled runs. Those revisions no longer constrain the limit; uncancelled active revisions still enforce their strictest limit.

compatibility.detail: A replacement run can be admitted immediately after cancellation, before final work or resource cleanup completes. Their original ownership and cleanup continue. Older binaries keep refusing admission until cancellation cleanup finishes.

manual.detail: The normal cancellation API frees the admission slot automatically.

recovery.detail: Existing final and cleanup states remain recoverable through normal reconciliation.
